summary: Implemented separate occurrence, matching-line and matching-file sinks over one bounded literal scan. Matches preserves every occurrence and projection multiplicity, lines emits one physical-line row with an occurrence count and decoded line text, and files emits one row after the first qualifying occurrence and stops reading that file.

implementation.scopeBoundary: Only the owning Search implementation, its schema metadata, tests and Search documentation were changed. No sibling repository, query-engine adapter, release, publish or install surface was modified.
implementation.sinkSemantics: A shared scanner sends each LiteralMatcher span to an occurrence sink, a physical-line aggregation sink or an existential file sink. The occurrence sink emits every span, the line sink removes each completed matching line from its bounded per-scan map, and the file sink emits once and returns from the reader loop.
implementation.lineSemantics: Line text is accumulated across reader blocks and includes the source newline when present. Separate text-line coordinates remain synchronized with matcher spans; the current decoded reader has no lossless byte mapping, so ByteOffset is null.
implementation.ownership: One pooled SearchCharBuffer is retained per source scan. Row chunks receive owned snapshots before sink staging lists are cleared; no row retains pooled input memory.
implementation.diagnostics: The shared source preserves typed Search open/read/output failures, cancellation propagation, reader disposal and existing scope traversal/counter behavior.

gateResults.evidence: The exact owning-repository Release suite exited 0 with 21 projects, 1,373 discovered, 1,339 passed, 0 failed and 34 skips; the focused Search suite exited 0 with 86 passed and 3 platform-conditional skips.

The separate ownership review approved the sink cardinalities, shared reader lifecycle, projection invariant and early-stop behavior; exact source/artifact hashes and the unique trailer-bearing completion commit are verified during post-commit finalization.

Direct and compiled Search tests agree with the declared occurrence, matching-line and matching-file units, including repeated paths, grouped line counts/text, zero-hit exclusion, projection invariance and cross-block line grouping.

The shared source retains one pooled reader buffer, snapshots every published chunk before reuse, propagates cancellation and disposes readers; the files sink stops after its first qualifying occurrence.

knownLimitations: The lines sink retains a decoded physical line in a StringBuilder; explicit line-size/resource budgeting remains a later scope concern.
The sources remain literal, case-sensitive, decoded-text sources. Byte matching, regex, multi-pattern sharing, virtual origins and count/audit rows remain later scopes.
The repository-wide suite retains 31 expected skips and 3 platform-conditional symlink skips, plus existing compiler/package-audit warnings; no package was published.
